name: Mountains south of Karazhan
shortDescription: Mountains south of Karazhan, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these Empty ashen slate crags, sparse cold grass and twisted branches in Deadwind Pass; a charred bone suggests the quest object without asserting an exact surveyed site.
